title: 8-bit synchronous counter with active-low reset
license: unspecified (repo has no LICENSE file as of 2026-06-02)
problemDescription: 8-bit binary up-counter. Async active-low reset clears to 0; otherwise increments by 1 on each rising clock edge. Reference TB uses 100 MHz clk (5ns half-period) and deasserts n_rst at t=10ns.
